title: Digit counter
prompt: Implement `static int CountDigits(string s)` — how many characters are decimal digits (use `char.IsDigit`, so `'٥'`-style Unicode digits count too — any `char.IsDigit` true). Null or empty yields 0.

tests.name: unicode
tests.hint: char.IsDigit (not '0'<=c&&c<='9') is what makes the Unicode digit count — that's the lesson.
